scope: Source-panel integrity, coverage and multiyear evaluation readiness, external scenario inputs, trace and three-language HTML; no new fitted demand forecasts.
findings: All 649,932 source pair-month aggregates were independently rebuilt; 104 non-airport/ambiguous groups (2,115 months) are retained separately. The working EU panel contains 6,214 airport pairs and 647,817 pair-months.
Both independently downloaded FRA–BCN reporter series match the collected panel over 240 months each. Source-update and mirror-index dates remain distinct.

With five full training years, the EU archive has 13/11/6 candidate origins and 15,868/14,653/6,331 complete pair-targets for 3/5/10 years. These are coverage counts, not model scores or independent experiments.
Regional units, all normalized rows and quality flags were checked. India duplicates, missing directions, missing months and annual completeness were independently rebuilt.

WDI history, WPP/IMF projections and all eight visa snapshots were independently normalized from raw rows. The five January 2026 Togo Medium replacements and warnings on unrevised Low/High variants pass.
Final RU/EN/DE numerical tables and twenty historical chart points pass; the older 2023–2024 experiment remains explicitly separated in closed details.
limitations: The Eurostat source is accessed through a dated DBnomics archive covering five reporters, not all Europe. PAS_CRD is on-flight O/D, not full journey demand.
DGCA original publications were not independently matched to the public Vonter transcription; the complete transcription and its processing were audited.
Current data revisions are not historical forecast vintages. The 2024 observed baseline requires a separate 2025–2026 nowcast before a 2026 issue can call 2029/2031/2036 its 3/5/10-year targets.
India domestic lacks May 2021 and May 2024 entirely; neither India panel currently supplies a ten-year evaluation window with five complete training years.
Airport/city identities, NUTS boundary harmonization, source flags and future feature vintages require modelling decisions before fitting. Missing target records are not zero demand.
External population variants and IMF projections are not a passenger forecast or confidence interval. No source GDP projection for 2036 was fabricated.
Visa snapshots are curator observations rather than independently verified legal histories. Passport citizenship is not inferred from departure country.
No fitted route or aircraft-choice result is claimed in this collection stage.
